decisions.thought:
Lead: 25% BRING: incineroar, 20% BRING: dragapult, 17% BRING: toxapex

Plan: Bring Fire+Water+Ground coverage for their Steel core (Corv/Aegi/Gholdengo). Rotom leads safe with Volt/WoW/TWave vs Pex/Incin/Corv. Dragonite mega sweeps with DD+ESpeed, Volc breaks steels. Watch Dragapult speed; cripple with TWave then ESpeed.
